This comes from `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses "rest at the inn" as its worked example. I didn't open the source files, so line numbers are the docs' figures and I haven't checked them.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add a `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` type. Add a cost constant, for example `INN_REST_COST`. The Worker owns the rules, so the price lives here and not in the frontend. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with a `POST /`. It validates the body and calls `getCharacter`. If `gold` is below the cost, it returns an error. Otherwise it calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, which only accepts whitelisted fields). Optionally it calls `askDM` for narration, `appendHistory` + `saveSession`, and inserts an `adventure_log` row, following `routes/action.ts`. It returns `updatedCharacter`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` (around lines 41-48) | Mount the route with `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. No CORS change is needed unless there is a new origin. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` | Only needed if other routes will share the logic. Otherwise skip. |
| `worker/migrations/000N_*.sql` | Not needed, since the feature uses existing `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` columns. If a schema change turns up, add a new migration and never edit `0001`. |

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface that mirrors the Worker response, including `updatedCharacter`. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` and `.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn" button and a handler. The handler calls the API, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` so the sheet updates. It then pushes a system or narrative entry, and shows an error if gold is insufficient. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. |

Any new component needs separate `.ts`, `.html`, `.css` and `.spec.ts` files. Inline templates are not allowed.

## Docs to update in the same change
- Update the doc beside each changed file under `docs/code/...`, and add a new doc for `routes/rest.ts` with links at both ends.
- Add the new doc to `code.md`.
- Re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- Add the endpoint to `docs/PRD.md` §9 (API spec).

## Cautions
- The AI must only narrate. Cost and HP math stay in the Worker.
- Inventory potion healing is currently browser-only and never saved (B-05). Don't copy that pattern. The rest route must persist HP through `updateCharacter`.
